entities.name: Marko Ivović
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Marko Ivović is a Serbian professional volleyball player who plays as an outside hitter for Lokomotiv Novosibirsk and the Serbia national team. He is the 2019 European Champion and the 2016 World League winner with Serbia.
